Hospitality and Tourism applications should improve service, communication, guest experience, or workflow. Food-contact and sanitation decisions are not styling details: materials and finishes need explicit approval for their actual use.

::: {.ter-curriculum-relevance}
**Food-safety boundary:** Treat classroom-fabricated pieces as non-food-contact prototypes unless every material, finish, fabrication residue, cleaning method, and local requirement has been verified. Do not use porous or unknown materials for direct food contact.
:::

## Project directions

:::: {.ter-project-grid}
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Accessible menu or information stand
<p class="ter-course-code">TFJ2O · Display family</p>
Design a stable stand for a menu, itinerary, or visitor message that remains readable in the intended lighting and viewing position.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Audience scenario → layout → card mock-up → stand prototype → readability test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Hierarchy, pricing/information accuracy, stability, accessibility</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Introductory · tabletop</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Cardboard proof; approved cleanable non-food-contact material</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Resist tipping, page slip, and common handling</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Keep away from food and heat unless specifically approved</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hospitality-tourism&type=project-components">Stand and sign components</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/02-make-it-stand.qmd">Make It Stand</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Produce bilingual or plain-language versions with equal hierarchy</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Service-station organizer prototype
<p class="ter-course-code">TFJ2O · Organizer family</p>
Improve a simulated service station by making stock levels, replenishment, and clean/used separation obvious.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Workflow map → zone plan → mock-up → timed simulation → revision</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>FIFO concepts, labels, reach, inventory, process communication</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · one dry-service zone</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Corrugated prototype or approved cleanable bins with dividers</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Stable when partially full; dividers removable for cleaning</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Simulated or packaged items only unless food-safe use is approved</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hospitality-tourism&type=core-geometry">Labels and frames</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../01-nice-design-process/02-investigate-inquire.qmd">Investigate & Inquire</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Compare setup time and restocking errors</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Portable visitor-information module
<p class="ter-course-code">Related tourism courses · Portable work module</p>
Build a flat-pack display for maps, event cards, and accessible local information at a simulated visitor station.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Visitor questions → content architecture → scale model → assembly test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Wayfinding, place research, branding, modular display</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · one-person carry</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Reused board, plywood, print media, standard fasteners</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Secure panels and test centre of mass</dd><dt>Safety</dt><dd>Do not block circulation or exits; protect personal data</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hospitality-tourism&type=themed-starters">Display design starters</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/05-assemblies-hybrid-fabrication.qmd">Assemblies + Hybrid Fabrication</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Add a low-bandwidth accessible digital companion</dd></dl>
:::
